hero.headline: Every wish, made real.
hero.lead: Based in Geneva, The Valet arranges your travel, your residence, your stays in the mountains and your events. The same person follows your request, from the first message to the final confirmation.

intro.title: Your time deserves our full attention
paragraphs: Our role is simple: to take the complexity out of your day. A table on a busy evening, a [chalet prepared before you arrive](/en/services/alpine-chalets-residences/), a gift that seems impossible to find, a family to meet at the airport: you tell us what you need, we arrange the rest and keep you informed at every step.

We work with private individuals, families and visitors in Geneva, around Lake Geneva, in Valais and in the resorts of the Swiss and French Alps. Some requests fit in a single message; others last a whole season. Either way, the person who answers you knows your habits and keeps track of the arrangements.

services.title: What we arrange
services.lead: A [private chauffeur in Geneva](/en/services/private-chauffeur-geneva/), [transfers to the Alpine resorts](/en/services/geneva-alps-transfers/), [private transport for your children](/en/services/private-child-transport/), a [private concierge](/en/services/private-concierge-geneva/) for everyday life, [management of your residence](/en/services/residence-management/), [chalets and residences in the Alps](/en/services/alpine-chalets-residences/), [weddings and private events](/en/services/weddings-private-events/) and a [Glam Team at home](/en/services/glam-team-at-home/). Alongside these, specialist services are coordinated with independent partners: [medical concierge](/en/services/medical-concierge/), [security and protection](/en/services/security-protection/), [legal and real estate introductions](/en/services/legal-real-estate/). Each service can be requested on its own or combined with others in a single arrangement.

chapters.title: Getting around
chapters.text: A [private chauffeur in Geneva](/en/services/private-chauffeur-geneva/) for a meeting, an evening or an airport arrival, a transfer to the resorts with luggage and skis, or your children's regular journeys to school and their activities. We give the driver the flight number, the exact address and your instructions, then follow the journey. For [private child transport](/en/services/private-child-transport/), the arrangements are agreed with the confirmed operator before booking.

chapters.title: Staying and hosting
chapters.text: We look for [chalets and residences in the Alps](/en/services/alpine-chalets-residences/) to suit your dates and your party, then prepare the arrival: house opened, shopping done, a chef or housekeeping if you wish. In Geneva, residence management looks after your home throughout the year or before you return. For a dinner, a birthday or a [wedding in Switzerland](/en/services/weddings-private-events/), we coordinate the venue, the providers and the timing, and the Glam Team comes to you for hair and make-up.

chapters.title: Being looked after
chapters.text: [Everyday concierge support](/en/services/private-concierge-geneva/) takes care of what takes time without needing you there: reservations, research, gifts, diary. For the logistics of medical appointments, security, or a legal or property matter, we introduce independent partners and coordinate the arrangements; we do not ourselves provide medical advice, legal advice or close protection. Every [security and protection](/en/services/security-protection/) request begins with an assessment.

items.title: Reliability
items.text: We confirm in writing who is involved and on what terms. Times, addresses and practical details are checked before each service, and we let you know when anything changes.

items.title: Discretion
items.text: Your request is handled with discretion: each provider receives only the information needed for their assignment.

items.title: Trust
items.text: We choose our providers with care and tell you clearly who is involved, in what capacity and on what terms.

items.title: Availability
items.text: Requests received 24 hours a day, 7 days a week; lead times and availability confirmed for each request. For a last-minute request, tell us so: we will let you know what is still possible.

items.title: Tailored
items.text: Every service starts from your schedule and your priorities, then adjusts as we get to know you.

steps.title: How it works
steps.lead: Three steps, whether the request is simple or involves several providers.

items.title: Tell us what you need
items.text: Through the [request form](/en/request/), by telephone or on WhatsApp. Give us the service, the date, the place and what matters to you; a few lines are enough to begin.

items.title: We confirm the details
items.text: You receive a clear proposal: what is possible, who will be involved, the lead times and the terms. Nothing is committed without your agreement.

items.title: We coordinate, you enjoy
items.text: We book, brief the providers and follow the service through to the end, including when plans change along the way.

destinations.title: Geneva and the Alps
destinations.lead: From Geneva, we arrange journeys and stays in the main resorts of the Swiss and French Alps.

partners.title: Who does what
paragraphs: The Valet coordinates: we receive your request, find the right solution, book, brief the providers and follow every step. Concierge support, residence management, stays, events and the Glam Team are organised by our team with providers we have chosen.

Passenger transport, security, medical, legal and real estate services are entrusted to independent partners, chosen for their authorised activity, who confirm the scope of their assignment and their terms with you. We introduce and coordinate; before any engagement, we confirm in writing who is involved and in what capacity.

items.q: What services does The Valet provide?
items.a: Transport and transfers, [concierge and personal assistance](/en/services/private-concierge-geneva/), residence management, chalets and stays, events and the Glam Team. See [all our services](/en/services/), including the specialist services coordinated with independent partners.

items.q: Can I reach you at any hour?
items.a: Requests received 24 hours a day, 7 days a week; lead times and availability confirmed for each request. For a busy date or a specialist service, please write to us as early as possible.

items.q: Where do you work?
items.a: In Geneva, Vaud, Valais, Gstaad, St-Moritz and the French resorts close to Geneva, with [transfers from Geneva to the Alps](/en/services/geneva-alps-transfers/) and [seasonal chalet rentals](/en/services/alpine-chalets-residences/). Other destinations are possible depending on the request.

items.q: Can several services be combined?
items.a: Yes. A transfer, the opening of a chalet by our [residence management service](/en/services/residence-management/), a chef and a reservation can be arranged together, and followed by the same person from start to finish.

items.q: How are prices set?
items.a: According to the scope of the request, the date, the place and the providers involved. You receive a proposal or estimate before any commitment: [describe your request](/en/request/) to obtain one.

items.q: What happens to the information I share with you?
items.a: It is used only to arrange your request and is passed only to the providers who need it. More answers are in our [full FAQ](/en/faq/).

closing.title: Tell us what you need
closing.text: A few lines are enough: the service, the date, the place. We will come back to you to confirm the details and suggest the next step.

about.metaTitle: About The Valet, concierge in Geneva
about.metaDescription: The Valet, a concierge based in Geneva: how we work, carefully chosen partners and clear commitments to every client.
about.title: Personal service, without fuss
about.intro: The Valet is a concierge based in Geneva, designed for people who value their time, their privacy and work done properly. We handle everyday needs and exceptional requests with the same attention, from the first conversation to the final confirmation.

paragraphs: The Valet was founded and is run by a woman. It shows less in what we say than in how we work: listening before proposing, noticing the details that matter to you, and preferring the right answer to a quick one that will need correcting.

We wanted a concierge on a human scale, where you know who is handling your request. No call centre, no forms left unanswered: one person who knows your file, your preferences and how you like to be kept informed, whether by a short message, a call or a written summary. That continuity matters more than the speed of a first reply: it avoids misunderstandings, duplication and repeated explanations.

Every request begins with a conversation. We try to understand what you really expect: the time that cannot move, the person who needs to be told, the detail that will change a journey or an evening. We then assess what is feasible, in what timeframe and with which providers.

You receive a clear proposal before any commitment. Once you agree, we book, brief the providers and follow every step. If a flight is delayed, if the weather closes a pass or if plans change, we adjust the arrangements and let you know.

With your consent, we keep a record of your preferences: the type of vehicle you like, how a house should be prepared, a child's allergies for a restaurant booking. The second request is then simpler than the first.

We coordinate much of the work ourselves: concierge, residence management, chalets and stays, events, the Glam Team. For regulated services, such as professional passenger transport, security, legal advice, real estate or medical care, we work with independent partners, chosen for their authorised activity, who act under their own responsibility.

We choose these partners with care and do not publish their names. Before each assignment, you know who will be involved, in what capacity and on what terms. On your side, you keep a single contact at The Valet, who links all the providers and remains responsible for following up your request.

We do not promise the impossible. When a date is full, a deadline is too short or a request goes beyond what we can arrange properly, we tell you and, where possible, suggest an alternative. We would rather say no clearly than make a commitment we could not keep properly.

We give neither legal advice nor medical advice, and we do not provide close protection ourselves: these assignments belong to professionals authorised to carry them out, whom we can introduce. Everything we arrange is described on our [services page](/en/services/). We display no testimonials or client names: your trust rests on the discretion we owe you, including when everything has gone well. To discuss a request, [contact our team](/en/contact/).

commitments.title: Our commitments
items: Confidential service that respects your privacy
Prompt replies and clear communication at every step
Careful selection of providers and partners
Solutions adapted to each person, rather than a ready-made formula
Attention to detail from preparation to completion

faq.metaTitle: FAQ: concierge in Geneva and the Alps
faq.metaDescription: Answers to common questions about The Valet: requests, availability, transport, residences, events, regulated services, privacy and pricing.
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Answers to the questions we are asked most often before a first request. If yours is not here, write to us: we are happy to answer, even a simple question.

items.q: How do I make a request?
items.a: Through the [request form](/en/request/), by email, by telephone or on WhatsApp. Tell us the service, the date, the place and the details that matter to you. We come back to you to confirm what is possible and suggest the next step.

items.q: Are you available around the clock?
items.a: Requests received 24 hours a day, 7 days a week; lead times and availability confirmed for each request. Specialist services also depend on the availability of the professionals involved. You can also [contact us directly](/en/contact/).

items.q: How far in advance should I contact you?
items.a: It depends on the service. A transfer or a reservation can sometimes be arranged quickly; a wedding, a chalet in high season or a security assignment need more notice. The earlier we hear from you, the wider the choice.

items.q: Can I make a one-off request?
items.a: Yes. You can come to us for a one-off request or for ongoing support, such as managing a residence or organising your stays for a season. The arrangements are agreed with you.

items.q: Which vehicles can you arrange?
items.a: Depending on availability and your needs: saloons, premium vans such as the Mercedes-Benz V-Class, and limousines. Our [private chauffeur service](/en/services/private-chauffeur-geneva/) is provided by independent partners, chosen for their authorised activity in professional passenger transport. Limousines are available on request, subject to operator availability.

items.q: Do you arrange transfers between Geneva and the resorts?
items.a: Yes, from Geneva to the main resorts of the Swiss and French Alps. Access to each resort is described on our [Geneva to Alps transfers](/en/services/geneva-alps-transfers/) page; for the stay itself, see our [chalets and residences in the Alps](/en/services/alpine-chalets-residences/).

items.q: Can you arrange regular transport for children?
items.a: Yes, for school, activities or appointments, subject to local regulations and prior confirmation. Child seats suited to the child's age and size, the person the child is handed over to and messages to parents are agreed with the confirmed operator before booking, following the family's written instructions. See [private child transport](/en/services/private-child-transport/).

items.q: Can I charter a private jet or a yacht?
items.a: On request, subject to operator availability, we can introduce independent operators for a private jet charter or a yacht rental. Itinerary, timings and terms are confirmed directly by the operator before any booking, and our [private concierge](/en/services/private-concierge-geneva/) then coordinates the rest of the trip.

items.q: What does personal assistance cover?
items.a: Diary and reservation management, researching and buying gifts, finding experiences or specialists, coordinating drivers and household providers, and unexpected requests. See our [private concierge](/en/services/private-concierge-geneva/).

items.q: Do you look after a residence?
items.a: Yes, on a regular or seasonal basis: cleaning, laundry, supplies, repair follow-up, keys and access, receiving visitors, gardening. We can also prepare a house before you arrive. See [residence management](/en/services/residence-management/).

items.q: Can you find a chalet or a private residence?
items.a: Yes, as a seasonal rental or for a short stay, in Switzerland and the French Alps. We search according to your dates, the number of guests, the style you prefer and the services expected on site, such as a chef or housekeeping. See our [chalets and residences in the Alps](/en/services/alpine-chalets-residences/).

items.q: Do you also book hotels abroad?
items.a: Yes. We find and book hotels worldwide according to your preferences for location, room category, dining or wellness, and coordinate transfers if you wish, through our [private concierge](/en/services/private-concierge-geneva/).

items.q: What events do you organise?
items.a: Weddings, private dinners and parties, birthdays, product launches and corporate evenings. We handle concept, venue, decoration, catering, entertainment, guest logistics and coordination on the day, as described on our [private events page](/en/services/weddings-private-events/).

items.q: Can you organise a wedding in Switzerland for guests travelling from abroad?
items.a: Yes. Beyond the event itself, we coordinate transfers, accommodation and guests' particular requests. See [weddings and private events](/en/services/weddings-private-events/).

items.q: Where does the Glam Team work?
items.a: At your home, your hotel or the event venue. Makeup, hair and styling are prepared in a first conversation about the occasion, your outfit and the result you want. See the [Glam Team at home](/en/services/glam-team-at-home/).

items.q: Can the Glam Team stay during the event?
items.a: On request, touch-ups during the event can be arranged, as well as skin preparation, a manicure or a pedicure beforehand. These are confirmed when you [book the Glam Team](/en/request/?service=glam-team).

items.q: How does a security request work?
items.a: Every assignment begins with an assessment of the situation. Services are provided by independent partners, chosen for their authorised activity, subject to availability, local law and the required licences. Specific capabilities are confirmed before engagement. See [security and protection](/en/services/security-protection/).

items.q: Do you give medical advice?
items.a: No. The Valet does not provide medical advice or treatment. We handle the logistics: booking appointments, transport, organising consultations. Care is delivered by independent healthcare professionals. See the [medical concierge](/en/services/medical-concierge/).

items.q: Can you advise me on a legal or property matter?
items.a: The Valet does not provide legal advice. We introduce you to independent lawyers or property professionals, who confirm the scope of their work and their fees directly with you. See [legal and real estate](/en/services/legal-real-estate/).

items.q: Why do you not name your partners?
items.a: Out of discretion, towards them as well as you. Before each assignment, you know who will be involved and in what capacity, and the partner confirms their own terms with you.

items.q: How do you protect my privacy?
items.a: We share your information only with the providers who need it for the agreed assignment, in line with applicable data protection rules. We do not name our clients.

items.q: Can I include medical or security information in the form?
items.a: Please do not. Simply describe the type of need; sensitive details are exchanged later, directly with the professional concerned, whether for the [medical concierge](/en/services/medical-concierge/) or [security](/en/services/security-protection/).

items.q: How are your prices calculated?
items.a: According to the scope of the request, the date, the place, the provider and the degree of personalisation. A proposal or estimate is provided once the request has been reviewed, before any commitment.

items.q: What if I need to change or cancel?
items.a: Let us know as soon as possible. Change and cancellation terms depend on the service and the provider; they are given to you with the proposal, before you confirm.

servicesHub.title: All our services
servicesHub.intro: The Valet brings together the services a full life needs: getting around, running a home, heading to the mountains, entertaining, getting ready for an occasion. Each service has its own page, but you can combine several requests in one conversation. An arrival in Geneva might bring together the airport chauffeur, the preparation of the house, a dinner reservation and a hair appointment the next day, coordinated by the same person, who confirms each element with you before committing to it.
paragraphs: Transport is often the first request. A [private chauffeur in Geneva](/en/services/private-chauffeur-geneva/) for a meeting, an evening or an airport arrival, [transfers between Geneva and the Alps](/en/services/geneva-alps-transfers/) with skis and luggage, or [private child transport](/en/services/private-child-transport/) for school runs and activities. These journeys are provided by independent partners, chosen for their authorised activity in professional passenger transport; we arrange them, brief the driver on your preferences and follow each journey until you have arrived.

The [private concierge](/en/services/private-concierge-geneva/) covers everything that takes time without needing you there: reservations, research, gifts, diary, unexpected requests. [Residence management](/en/services/residence-management/) looks after the house, regularly or before an arrival. For the mountains, we find [chalets and residences in the Alps](/en/services/alpine-chalets-residences/) and coordinate what makes a good stay: chef, housekeeping, ski equipment, transfers.

For special occasions, we organise [weddings and private events](/en/services/weddings-private-events/), from concept to coordination on the day, and the [Glam Team](/en/services/glam-team-at-home/) comes to your home, hotel or venue for hair, makeup and styling.

Finally, some needs call for specialist professionals. The [medical concierge](/en/services/medical-concierge/) handles the logistics of your appointments, without replacing a doctor's advice. [Security and protection](/en/services/security-protection/) begin with an assessment. For [legal and real estate matters](/en/services/legal-real-estate/), we introduce independent lawyers and professionals, who confirm the scope of their work with you.

journal.metaTitle: News: Geneva, the Alps, the seasons
journal.metaDescription: The Valet news: practical notes on Geneva, the Alpine resorts, the seasons and major events, to help you prepare your stays with less effort.
journal.title: News
journal.intro: Practical notes written by The Valet team to help you prepare a stay, a season or an event in Geneva and the Alps. We publish rarely, and only when we have something useful to share: no trend lists, no sponsored content, no rankings of addresses.
paragraphs: Here you will find what we often explain to clients: how to prepare an [arrival in Zermatt](/en/services/geneva-alps-transfers/#zermatt); what to think about before [opening a chalet for the season](/en/services/alpine-chalets-residences/); how to [organise a wedding in Switzerland](/en/services/weddings-private-events/) when half the guests are coming from abroad; what changes in Geneva during the major fairs and conferences, when hotels, tables and [private chauffeurs in Geneva](/en/services/private-chauffeur-geneva/) are booked well in advance. We also write about the seasons: the resorts opening in early winter, the school holiday weeks when everything fills up, summer in the mountains, the quieter Geneva autumn that suits work on a residence.

These articles stay general. They do not replace legal advice, medical advice or the opinion of a security professional, and practical information such as timetables, access or local rules can change: check it at the time of your stay, or ask us to do so for you. We name no clients, partners or establishments: the advice stays practical and valid wherever you are staying.

Each article links to the relevant service, whether [managing a villa in Geneva](/en/services/residence-management/), [getting ready before a wedding](/en/services/glam-team-at-home/) or a [chalet stay in Verbier](/en/services/alpine-chalets-residences/#verbier). We show the update date of each text and regularly review the most-read ones so they stay accurate from one season to the next. If a question comes to mind as you read, the simplest thing is to [write to us](/en/contact/): we are glad to answer, even before there is a request, and we keep your questions to shape future articles.
journal.empty: The first articles are on their way; until then, we are happy to answer your questions directly.
